profile_text.body:
IBM is a public company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY. As of the end of 2025, the company reported revenue of $67,535,000,000. IBM's website describes IBM OpenPages as a scalable, AI-powered GRC platform that helps organizations manage risk, compliance, and audit functions in one integrated solution, available on any cloud or on-premises with modular deployment options. The platform uses embedded AI to automate classification and issue creation across governance, risk, and compliance activities.

IBM offers three tracked AI products. IBM OpenPages with Watson is a full GRC platform with AI-specific modules for risk assessment, regulatory mapping, and Watson AI automated documentation. IBM watsonx.governance provides AI lifecycle governance, model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation, with EU AI Act accelerators; Gartner named it a Leader in its first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026. IBM watsonx is the company's broader enterprise AI platform, offering model-agnostic governance for agent inventory, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection. IBM OpenPages includes an MCP Server that securely enables AI agents to create, query, and update GRC objects while simplifying integration with agent frameworks.

The company has significant legal exposure in New York, with 342 cases tracked in that jurisdiction. IBM was verified as a public company on September 12, 2026, with a CIK of 0000051143 and ticker symbol IBM.
